words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) does not start an independent condition; it reaches back to the prior non-forgetting promise in 87:6 and keeps the assurance bounded only by what God wills. The opening therefore makes 87:6-7 one syntactic unit: the promise is qualified before its divine agent and rationale are stated.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens by grammatically limiting 87:6, not by starting a detached thought.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:illā mā shāʾa Allāhu}}) as an exception span licensed by the immediately preceding negated clause in 87:6.

topics.headline: only the willed exception remains

topics.reason: The local restriction routes any exception through {{ar:مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:mā shāʾa Allāhu}}), so the limit is divine willing rather than an independent breach.

topics.reason: The word order places the exception frame first, then the divine subject, then the emphatic knowledge clause.

Its openness can be heard as what God wills, or as the fact of God's willing, and the later {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) in the hiddenness phrase echoes that unspecified domain under knowledge.

topics.reason: The particle functions as the exception content and object-domain of {{ar:شَآءَ}} ({{tr:shāʾa}}), with no gender, number, suffix, or lexical narrowing.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the exception can cover both the thing excepted and the divine willing that grounds the exception.
topics.reason: Local grammar supports {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) as the object-domain of the will verb; a maṣdar-like construal is kept as a cautious semantic possibility rather than a replacement of the local object relation.

topics.reason: Both particles are locally present: the first heads the exception content, and the second heads the hidden object-domain.

words.prose: {{ar:شَآءَ}} ({{tr:shāʾa}}) makes the exception a settled act of divine willing, not a future instability in the promise. The fronted {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is the willed domain, and the explicit subject follows, so possible forgetting is reframed as governed volition. The root's thinghood associations make the exception feel like a selected matter, while the local Form I verb keeps direct willing as the active sense; the following {{ar:يَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamu}}) then grounds that will in knowledge. The familiar divine-will formula field, visible by comparison with contingency language such as 2:20, is narrowed here to retained recitation and points forward to facilitated aid (87:8).

topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) as the explicit object-domain of {{ar:شَآءَ}} ({{tr:shāʾa}}), with {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) as the explicit subject.

topics.reason: The bundle has no V4 rows for this root, so the CRITICAL root-pressure is retained cautiously; local grammar still selects direct willing rather than a separate thing-making sense.

The proper name prevents the boundary from being assigned to fate or an unnamed force, and it immediately prepares the emphatic resumption in {{ar:إِنَّهُۥ}} ({{tr:innahu}}). Derivational pressure around deity, worship, and awe may color the name, but the local form remains the fixed Qur'anic proper name.

topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) the explicit subject of {{ar:شَآءَ}} ({{tr:shāʾa}}).

words.prose: {{ar:يَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamu}}) is the continuous predicate inside the emphatic frame, with its subject supplied by the pronoun in {{ar:إِنَّهُۥ}} ({{tr:innahu}}). One transitive verb governs both {{ar:ٱلْجَهْرَ}} ({{tr:al-jahra}}) and {{ar:مَا يَخْفَىٰ}} ({{tr:mā yakhfā}}), so the reason for the exception is staged as knowledge spanning opposite perceptual domains. The root's marking and discernment field can sharpen the sense of knowing distinctions, while the local Form I verb keeps knowledge itself, not teaching or informing, as the selected action. The broader divine-knowledge field includes the secret-and-more-hidden pairing (20:7), but here that reach explains the reservation and keeps it from sounding arbitrary.

words.prose: {{ar:يَخْفَىٰ}} ({{tr:yakhfā}}) completes the relative phrase by predicating concealment of {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) without needing another object. Its imperfect form keeps hiddenness ongoing, so divine knowledge includes what remains concealed before any exposure. The root field allows secrecy, subtlety, and obscurity to thicken the concealed pole, while local Form I grammar selects a state of being hidden rather than someone causing concealment or uncovering it. The same hiddenness field is intensified by secret-and-more-hidden knowledge (20:7) and private supplication (19:3), while 87:7 generalizes it to whatever is hidden. As the final word, it closes the ayah at the farthest side of ordinary perception.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exception construction "except what Allah wills" is immediately followed by the reason-like assertion that He knows the overt and whatever hides.
baseline_models.mechanism: Willing selects or brings about a knowable thing, while knowledge spans both public disclosure and concealment. The exception therefore marks a volitional boundary inside a complete epistemic field, not an item escaping knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Will directed toward a thing supplies the selecting agency of the exception and may include bringing the selected thing about.
The fixed divine name identifies the willing and knowing subject rather than leaving the exception impersonal.
A thing becoming clear to a knower supplies comprehensive apprehension as the frame around the exception.
Open declaration and raised voice supply the publicly available pole of what is known.
Covering and secrecy supply the inaccessible-to-others pole that remains equally within knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The exception can sound like an unexplained interruption, followed by a generic statement of omniscience.
changed_reading.after: The knowledge clause constrains how the exception is heard: willing operates with no blind side across both disclosure and concealment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object pair is not merely "the visible and the hidden": one term can name acts of making apparent, while the other is the verbal "whatever hides."
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch inventories make manifestation reversible and graded. Water can be cleared into appearance, a cover can be removed, and a concealed flash can glimmer without becoming fully public. Knowledge thus reaches the transitions by which something hides, leaks through, or becomes manifest.

activation_trace.role: Cleaning a well until its water appears turns overt presence into the result of a material disclosure process.
Removing a cover shows that the concealment root itself can carry the reversal from hidden to exposed.
A faint flash within cloud supplies an intermediate state that is neither fully concealed nor fully manifest.
Knowing as disclosure to the knower gathers every stage of the visibility gradient into one apprehension.

changed_reading.before: The verse divides objects into two static bins, public and hidden.
changed_reading.after: The verse also knows a moving threshold: concealment, partial glimmer, extraction, and full disclosure are all already apprehended.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence "He knows the overt and whatever hides" joins a knowledge root that can denote a guiding mark to outward appearance and covered interiors.
baseline_models.mechanism: An outward mark can identify and guide toward something not itself present to view. The overt/hidden pair can therefore be read semiotically: public signs and the concealed realities to which they point are both known, without knowledge being reduced to inference from the sign.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that guides to a thing supplies the relation between an available sign and an absent referent.
Plain appearance to the eye supplies the publicly legible surface of the sign relation.
Covers and inner things supply realities not exhausted by what their outward marks disclose.
The knowable and reportable thing gives the sign a determinate object rather than treating signs as free-floating symbols.

changed_reading.before: Knowing the overt and hidden is an exhaustive inventory of two classes of facts.
changed_reading.after: It can also name direct command of both public evidence and the concealed referents, causes, or interiors that evidence only indicates.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured formation and guidance lead into bringing pasture out, then transforming it into dark floating residue. This activates the focus pair as phases of a governed material cycle: what was hidden emerges openly, and what flourished openly is darkened, contained, or carried away, all within informed willing.

activation_trace.role: Will toward a thing anchors the context's ordered transformations back in the focus exception.
Water made apparent by clearing supplies a material image for emergence into the open.
Extraction from under cover makes hiddenness a reversible phase rather than a permanent class.
Measuring and proportioning a thing supplies an ordered beginning rather than accidental appearance.
Managing by estimation and foresight supplies the governing logic of the sequence.
Gentle direction toward a path turns measured capacity into directed development.
Bringing a thing out of concealment explicitly links the growth scene to the focus visibility threshold.
Causing a thing to become another state supplies the reversal from pasture to residue.
Debris floating on a torrent supplies the exposed remnant of a prior living state.
Blackness or red tending to black supplies the obscuring terminal phase of the visible growth.

structural_cues: 87:2-5 repeats the same relative subject and uses tightly linked result clauses, yielding a sequence from formation through emergence to transformation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measurement, guidance, extraction, transformation, floating residue, and darkening; I supply the lifecycle arrow that treats them as successive visibility states governed by informed will. A live alternative is that the clauses enumerate separate powers without making visibility their organizing axis.

changed_reading.before: The overt and hidden are two simultaneous domains surveyed by knowledge.
changed_reading.after: They become stages in a governed cycle of emergence and recession: what is concealed can be brought forth, and what is manifest can be transformed into dark remainder.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recitation moves gathered language from latent possession into voiced articulation; forgetting removes it from ready access, while ease, reminder, and written sheets preserve routes of recovery. The exception now reads as a divinely governed limit on retention or retrieval, and the knowledge clause spans both audible output and what remains inward or unavailable.

activation_trace.role: Will directed toward a thing makes the exception an active retention boundary rather than a random lapse.
Complete apprehension prevents human inaccessibility through forgetting from becoming divine inaccessibility.
The voiced consonant supplies a precise phonetic form for the recitation's publicly articulated layer.
Inner and physically covered things supply the latent, unuttered, or temporarily inaccessible layer.
Reading, reciting, and causing recitation provide the concrete operation immediately bounded by the exception.
Loss from remembrance supplies the access failure to which the exception grammatically attaches.
Opening into ease after difficulty supplies a facilitated route from latent possession to usable recitation.
Bringing something back after forgetting supplies recovery rather than treating absence from recall as erasure.
The written sheet externalizes language into a durable public support for what memory may not presently surface.
Priority and beginning extend the recitation-memory mechanism backward into earlier textual transmission.

structural_cues: 87:6 immediately precedes the focus exception, while 87:9-10 repeat remembrance and 87:18-19 close with written sheets.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciting, not forgetting, ease, recollection, and written sheets; I infer that overt maps to voiced availability and hidden to latent or inaccessible memory. The live alternative is that the focus contrast remains universally public/private and only the exception, not the knowledge pair, concerns recitation.

changed_reading.before: The exception limits an unspecified divine act, and overt/hidden remain general objects of knowledge.
changed_reading.after: The exception governs recitational retention, while divine knowledge holds together the sounded text, its latent memory, and what may drop from human access without dropping from knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast between choosing the near life and the later, better, more lasting one creates two selection regimes. Human preference is pulled toward what is near and presently apparent; the focus attributes divine willing to a knower of both the apparent and concealed, so its selection is not confined by immediacy.

activation_trace.role: Will toward a thing supplies the divine selection term that the later human preference sharpens by contrast.
Full apprehension gives divine selection an epistemic range unavailable to preference governed by nearness.
Plain appearance supplies the currently available pole toward which near-term preference can be biased.
Concealment supplies outcomes not presently available to sight but still included in informed willing.
Preferring one thing by choice supplies the explicit human counterpart to willing.
Nearness supplies the temporal and perceptual bias of the chosen present life.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Exception under will and total knowledge.** Lexical evidence: ش ي ء B001/B002 (willing/choosing a thing), ء ل ه B002 (Allah as fixed divine name), ع ل م B001 (knowing as clear apprehension), ج ه ر B001/B002 (open declaration/visible manifestation), خ ف ي B001 (hiddenness). Structural cue: exception to non-forgetting is immediately grounded in knowledge of public and hidden. Assigned role: divine will governs any exception; divine knowledge covers both recited aloud and concealed. Abductive move: the exception is not a memory failure outside control but a known, willed boundary. Reading change: the ayah protects the promise from absolutist misunderstanding.

2. **Hidden-to-open mechanism for revelation.** Lexical evidence: خ ف ي B003 (removing concealment), ج ه ر B001 (open voicing), ق ر ء B001/B002 in 87:6, ذ ك ر B004/B009 in 87:9. Structural cue: recitation precedes declared/hidden knowledge, and reminder follows. Assigned role: revelation moves from divine knowledge of hiddenness to public voicing. Abductive move: what is recited is a controlled disclosure of what could remain hidden. Reading change: "He knows the declared and hidden" becomes the epistemic source of reminder.

3. **Visible marks and misreading guard.** Lexical evidence: ع ل م B002 (distinguishing mark), ص ح ف B005 in 87:18-19 (misreading from written sheets), ق ر ء B002 (recitation/teaching). Structural cue: the surah ends with sheets, while here knowledge includes what is manifest. Assigned role: divine knowledge functions as the perfect marker preventing confusion between declared and hidden. Abductive move: human media can misread signs; divine knowledge marks them without error. Reading change: 87:7 stabilizes the transmission chain.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The final صحف made the declared/hidden contrast into a transmission concern: sheets can reveal, but also risk misreading, whereas divine علم fully marks what is public and concealed. 87:9-10 made hidden receptivity in the hearer important too.

reader_b.activated_readings_md:
1. **Exception grounded in divine will and total knowledge.** Lexical evidence: شيء B001 willing/volition and B002 willing/choosing; ءله B002 fixed divine name; علم B001 knowing as clear; جهر B001 open voicing; خفي B001 hiddenness. Structural cue: exception clause is followed by "He knows the open and what hides." Assigned role: divine will sets the boundary of the anti-forgetting promise; knowledge covers both recited and concealed domains. Abductive move: the packet supplies exception, will, and knowledge; I infer that the exception is not instability but sovereign scope. Reading change: the ayah becomes a controlled reservation inside preservation.

2. **Open recitation and hidden memory are both known.** Lexical evidence: جهر B001 aloud declaration/recitation and B002 visible manifestation; خفي B002 inner/hidden things; قرء B001 recitation and نسي B001 recall-loss in 87:6. Structural cue: the open/hidden pair directly follows recitation/forgetting. Assigned role: جهر is the voiced output; خفي is the unvoiced retained or concealed layer. Abductive move: the packet supplies public voice and hidden cover; I infer memory/utterance polarity. Reading change: the ayah reads as assurance over both performance and inward retention.

3. **Revealing hidden things parallels pasture emergence.** Lexical evidence: خفي B003 removing concealment/bringing out; خرج B002 causing emergence in 87:4; علم B002 distinguishing mark/sign. Structural cue: earlier emergence of pasture and later emergence of reminder frame a knowledge statement. Assigned role: divine knowledge is the capacity to mark and reveal what is covered. Abductive move: the packet supplies hiddenness/revealing and emergence; I infer epistemic emergence as analogous to vegetal emergence. Reading change: "knows the open and hidden" becomes active disclosure, not passive awareness.

4. **Hearing/listening variant of will links to reminder.** Lexical evidence: شيء B005/B006 listening closely variants; رعي B004 granting attentive hearing; ذكر B009 reminder in 87:9. Structural cue: after divine knowing, the text commands reminding if benefit occurs. Assigned role: the will/thing root's listening variants weakly activate a communicative reception field. Abductive move: the packet supplies listening branches but the surface شاء chiefly signals will; I infer only an exploratory auditory undertone because later reminder requires hearers. Reading change: the exception sits in a communication system where what is heard, spoken, and hidden is governed.
reader_b.retrospective_surprises_md: 87:9-11 clarified that "الجهر وما يخفى" also applies socially: reminder is public, but only the one with خشية responds while the avoidant turns aside. 87:18-19 added another open/hidden axis: what is presently recited was already held in earlier written sheets.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The exception invokes effective, informed volition.** The will-toward-a-thing variant of `ش ي ء/B002` includes willing with an implication of bringing about or attaining the thing; the disfigurement variant is not used here. `ع ل م/B001` immediately supplies comprehensive knowing, and 87:6 provides the protected process to which the exception attaches. Will serves as the selective causal operator, while knowledge supplies its complete informational field. I infer that the proximity makes the volition informed and effective rather than arbitrary. The exception reads as a controlled parameter of the recitation-memory process.
2. **Knowledge spans vocal output and concealed uptake.** `ج ه ر/B001` covers open voicing and recitation aloud, while `خ ف ي/B001` covers hiddenness and secrecy. Causative recitation in 87:6 and outward reminder in 87:9 are followed by inward recollection or avoidance in 87:10–11. The two branches divide the mechanism into emitted speech and concealed response. I infer that these later responses are among the hidden matters known; the packet does not explicitly identify them as the object. The clause reads diagnostically across expression and interior reception, not as an unstructured totality.
3. **Manifest behavior functions as a mark of hidden orientation.** `ع ل م/B002` is a distinguishing mark that points to something, and `ج ه ر/B002` is plain manifestation. The split between the one who recollects in 87:10 and the one who avoids in 87:11 provides two visible marks, while `خ ف ي/B001` supplies the concealed disposition they index. I supply the arrow from behavior to inward state. This changes `يَعْلَمُ` from simple possession of facts into knowledge that reads outward signs together with what lies beneath them.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The later split in 87:10–11 made the manifest/hidden pair behavioral rather than merely abstract: recollection and avoidance are visible signs pointing toward concealed orientation. 87:12 added a further surprise through `ن و ر/B001`: what was hidden can be exposed by the very fire encountered after avoidance.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir su birikimi türü tanımlamaz; aynı sözlük biçimi için deniz ve suyu bol kuyu olmak üzere iki ayrı karşılık verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak geçici çerçevedeki ortak su kütlesi görüntüsü yerine bu açık seçeneklilik tanıma yazılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Deniz ile suyu bol kuyu tek bir ara nesnede birleştirilmez; bunlar aynı biçimin kaynaklarda verilen iki ayrı sözlük karşılığıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak sözlük biçiminin deniz ve suyu bol kuyu karşılıklarını ayrı ayrı korur; bunlardan genel bir su birikintisi anlamı türetmez.

concept_map.definition: Aynı sözlük biçiminin bir kullanımda denizi, başka bir kullanımda ise suyu bol kuyuyu adlandırmasıdır. İki karşılık, genel bir su birikintisi anlamında kaynaştırılmaz.

facets.statement: Dal, aynı adın iki ayrı su varlığına verilen sözlük karşılıklarını birlikte kaydeder.
Bir kaynak karşılığında ad, geniş tuzlu su kütlesi olan denizi gösterir.
Diğer ve daha yaygın kaynak karşılığında ad, suyu çok olan kuyuyu gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu tanıklık iki karşılığı yan yana verir: bir aktarım sözcüğü deniz olarak açıklar, öteki tanıklıklar ise suyu bol kuyu anlamını destekler. Kaynaklara özgü ayrı claim kimlikleri bulunmadığı için bu karşıtlık ortak özet içinde, atıf uydurulmadan korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir sözü ya da işi gizli tutmayıp açıkça duyulur duruma getirmek; konuşma ve okuma bağlamında sesi yükseltmek, ses niteliğinde ise yüksek veya gür olmaktır.

facets.statement: Bir sözü ya da işi gizlilikten çıkarıp açıkça duyurma ve açığa vurma.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi, örten nesne ile saklı kalan şey ortaklığının yanında kanadın iç tüyleri, hurmanın iç yaprakları, görünmeyen varlıklar, kuyu ve koruluk gibi sözlüksel olarak yerleşmiş referansları da aynı dalda toplar. Hazırlanmış çerçeve kullanılabilir; ancak bu referansların tek bir nesne türü değil, örtme veya saklılık bağıyla adlandırılmış ayrı sözlüksel gerçekleşmeler olduğu açık tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal ad ve referans ağırlıklıdır; gizleme eyleminin kendisi, saklılığı giderme işlemi ve zayıf şimşek parlaması bu nominal kapsamın dışında kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel olarak örten veya saklı kalan şey çekirdeği, yalnız belirli biçimlerde yaşayan tüy, yaprak, kuyu, koruluk, görünmeyen varlık ve kalıplaşmış betimlemelerden ayrılır; bu özel adlandırmalar yalın anlamın tümüne yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi görüşten saklayan örtü veya kendisi görünmeyen, içeride kalan ya da gizli sayılan şey için kullanılan adlandırmadır. Kanadın iç tüyleri, hurmanın göbeğe yakın yaprakları, görünmeyen varlıklar, kuyu ve koruluk gibi referanslar bu çekirdeğe bağlı sözlüksel uzmanlaşmalardır.

facets.statement: Bir nesne başka bir şeyi örter veya kendisi saklı ve görünmez durumda bulunur.
Kanadın ön tüylerinin gerisinde kalan iç tüyler ile hurmanın göbeğine yakın yapraklar saklı konumları üzerinden adlandırılır.
Görünmeyen bir varlık veya bedende gizlendiğine inanılan böyle bir varlık, saklılık niteliğiyle adlandırılır.
Kuyu, sık ağaçlık ve saklı yer gibi çevresinden gizlenen mekânlar bu adlandırmanın sözlüksel uzmanlaşmalarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi bu dalı açıkça gizlemenin karşı yönü olarak kurar: saklı bir şeyin gizliliği giderilir, görünür kılınır veya bulunduğu yerden çıkarılır. Yağmurun hayvanları yuvalarından çıkarması ve gizli şeyi çıkarma kullanımları, ortaya çıkarma çekirdeğinin somut gerçekleşmeleridir; hazırlanmış çerçeve bu katılımcı ve sonuç ilişkisini korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Gizliliği giderip ortaya çıkarma çekirdeği ile sırrın belli olmasını, yağmurun hayvanları yuvalarından çıkarmasını ve gizli şeyi çekip almayı anlatan biçim ve söz öbekleri ayrılır; bu özel koşullar yalın çekirdeğe genellenmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi. Genel parlama, ani parıltı, kesintisiz çakma, bulutta yayılan çakma ve geniş görünür parlaklık adayları yayımlanan ayrımları oluşturdu; sıvı ve yüzey parıltısı yalnız uzak bir ışık benzerliğiydi, gündüz aydınlığı ile kara bulut aynı gök alanında farklı olaylardı, üç kardeş dal ise gizlilik, gizleyen referans ve ortaya çıkarma üzerinden yalnız dolaylı çağrışım sundu.

root_profile.summary: Kök, gizli kalma ve gizleme çekirdeği çevresinde bu niteliği taşıyan nesne ve referansları, aynı durumun karşı yönü olan açığa çıkarmayı ve ayrı bir dal olarak şimşeğin zayıf parlamasını örgütler. İlk üç dal gizlilik ekseninde durum, ad ve yön değişimini paylaşırken son dal belli belirsiz görünme niteliğiyle sınırlı bir doğa olayını anlatır.
